placed_museums.name: placed_museums
placed_museums.truth: A room offers space; a sequence decides whether there is anything to show. These are the first maps in the corpus whose artifacts were placed by measurement rather than by hand.
placed_museums.description: Generated museums. NOT a curriculum sequence — this exists so the placed maps belong to something, because every --all tool in this project walks sequences, and a map in no sequence is a map that nothing tests.
learning_objectives: none — these are compositions, not lessons

placed_museums.note: Two methods live here. The Placed_/Spine_/Fifty_ rooms were sized FIRST and filled to a density. The Ribbon_ halls were cut to fit what they hold — the wall is the remainder — which is the model that supersedes the other.
